reviews.text: Echo other reviews. They don't answer emails, schedule specialist appointments, respond to calls. Multiple times I've had bad news from tests given to me weeks or months later than they said they would come, had appointments with specialists forgotten about, gaslighted 'you refused the medication/appointment'. Something is seriously wrong with this practice. The individual people are not evil/mean, but as a practice patients don't seem to come first.
Excellent

Went here for my dog’s yearly vaccines. The doctors are great - giving 2 stars for the team in charge of appointments, emails and their front desk who are always so cold. Called them regarding an issue, they told me to email them but when I do they can’t even answer back.
Thank you so much for your trust! 🐾 It's a pleasure to work with you and your companion. …
Thank you for your comments. We hope Simone is feeling better. Looking forward to hearing from you :)
Great experience. Young, dynamic, and respectful team.

No transparency on pricing; they asked for an estimate for specific procedures, which, of course, is subject to revision based on the assessment and treatment plan recommended during the visit. For example, we know there will be a heartworm test. They can't even give a price range because it changes "depending on the client." Some things are standardized, but it's clear they want to take advantage of being in an affluent neighborhood to keep their prices "flexible." It's becoming increasingly difficult to find clinics that prioritize providing necessary, affordable, relevant, and transparent quality care rather than their own profits. A shame.

I had a very difficult experience:
I was told, in a very authoritarian manner, that it wasn't up to me to determine the diagnosis of my cat, who was experiencing a recurrence of a urinary tract infection—hence my presence—but that it was the veterinarian's responsibility to decide which tests to perform to determine the diagnosis, not mine.
A simple "That's perfect, we'll look at it together" would have been much more appropriate and appreciated.
I was told, in a very authoritarian manner, not to interrupt the veterinarian and to let her speak, even though I was asking questions, trying to understand or explain the situation with my cat, and she wasn't listening to me.
I was made to look like the bad guy, an aggressive person, in a situation where it was the veterinarian who was being aggressive towards me, by ordering me to be quiet.

Being made to feel guilty by the vet, who told me that because of me she lost consciousness... because she also has health problems...
Luckily, the vet brought in a third person "to manage me because I was too aggressive"... and I was finally able to ask all my questions about the test results, the treatment, and the follow-up... without her yelling at me to stop cutting her.
Thank you for these 5 stars, it's a real encouragement for our entire team. We remain committed to the well-being of your companions and thank you for your loyalty 🐾 …

Extremely rude and disrespectful staff, and very incompetent too.

I called about making an initial visit for my cat and asked for medication to calm her down before coming (this was a Monday). They said it was possible and to come the following day to pick it up. Upon my arrival the next day (Tuesday), to my surprise, the medication wasn’t prepared and now I had to get approval from a vet, which they didn’t have present. My appointment was the next day. The technician also told me that they couldn’t prescribe this medication before seeing the cat…

I was never told that my cat needed to have an initial visit to prescribe this medication when I spoke to staff over the phone. In fact, they told me that they were going to prepare it that day with the Vet because there were going to be no vets in the following day (Tuesday) and that I can just pass by to get it.

The technician was also extremely rude on top of it. Instead of being apologetic when I said calmly I think I’ll go to another vet for my cat the technician waved her hand and told me “ok go”.

I’ve had issues with this clinic before when my dog was around, but this was the cherry on top.

0 competency, 0 respect, and 0 human skills.
Take your pet elsewhere if you want a quality service.

I never got angry or rude to staff. Curious to see the ridiculous reply they’ll give beyond just taking ownership that staff is rude, systems always broken, and not knowledgeable reception.

I find the veterinarians to be good and caring, and the service is quite fast. However, I definitely felt the first time they tried to quickly push me to buy unnecessary and expensive products. I didn't appreciate this pressure. I went to this clinic because the shelter where I adopted my dog ​​had an arrangement with them for his initial basic care.

When I called back to schedule treatment for my dog, I asked to have a stool test done before the appointment. I don't understand why they first wanted to force me into a $128 appointment (very expensive compared to clinics here) only to then have tests done and make me book another $128 appointment. Having experienced a similar situation with my previous dog six years ago, and having had her stool tested beforehand by the vet (before the appointment), I see this as a great opportunity for them to make money. Knowing that this clinic is part of the Daubigny veterinary group, and given the monopoly it holds, coupled with the price increases in Quebec veterinary fees due to these foreign investors, I wonder if my pet's health is truly being prioritized or if it's simply a matter of business.

Furthermore, the receptionist's passive-aggressive behavior, constantly interrupting me until I finally asked her to listen, only to then tell me I was being confrontational, did nothing to address my concern: why schedule an earlier appointment if my dog ​​needs a stool test and the results for proper follow-up? In short, I think I'll start looking for a local clinic without foreign interests that are only there to empty our pockets without considering what's most important: our animals' health.

Hello, we're sorry to hear that your experience didn't meet your expectations. We'd like the opportunity to better understand your experience. Please feel free to contact our team directly so we can discuss it with you.
Thank you for sharing your experience with us! We're delighted you enjoyed the care your pet received. 🐾 …

Service at this veterinary clinic is a mixed bag — most of the staff members are very nice and accommodating, but I recently had a negative experience over the phone and there have been other moments of confusion in the past. It is possible that the audio on their phone isn’t very clear.

They’ve been having issues with their computer system, which was understandable at first, but now it has persisted for months. Over the course of these months, it has entailed not receiving my emails, not being able to access my pet’s file, as well as appointment information.

One positive is that the clinicians really take their time during consultation and answer questions.

Also, the services are more expensive than other clinics without significant differences. This is not to say that the prices are unreasonable, just that I’ve found cheaper and better elsewhere. I have since changed my primary clinic.

First time for my cat Yoyo. A friendly person who took good care of my cat Yoyo and gave good advice. I recommend them.

I will come back for my cat Cooki. Thank you.

They take good care of my pet. You can renew prescriptions by email and then pick them up, which is convenient. However, a consultation costs $128. I think that's expensive, but at the same time… things are getting expensive everywhere.

Absolutely love every interactions I had with them (over the phone or in person). The staff is so helpful, compasisonate, lovely and kind. The veterinarians & technicians are also really welcoming, lovely, experienced. You can really feel the love and respect they have for animals ✨️ & they are always willing to help with anything. I felt like all my questions were welcomed and the vet took his time to really answer and give me the necessary details about treatments, next steps, options available and explanations of diagnosis. The approach he used to simply connect with my fur babies before even going into their medical exam told me everything....They truly care. I was never rushed also which made the whole experience so lovely. Absolutely recommend them if you are looking for a vet clinic! They are probably the best in town in my opinion.
They are nice peolple.
Very friendly staff and extremely professional. The vet did a comprehensive exam and explained her recommendations in great detail. Excellent all around experience.
Thank you! Merci! :)

Wonderful visit with Dr. Olivia today! Thank you for your kindness and invaluable help! I am truly grateful.
Thank you to her assistant Thomas as well, so sweet and kind! You are angels. Thank you for everything.

Very  happy with the service. My own vet refused to put down my 14 year old who was dying of cancer without testing x rays and medication, absolutely ridiculous. I call you guys and the next day he was put down. No extra fees but a huge mass was found.we both can't thank you enough as it was hard enough. Thank you 💙 …

I had a really bad experience when I took my cat to get checked up. I went in for a simple checkup since my kitten had ear surgery before I adopted her. Two main issues I had with this clinic: 1) my cat is a very young kitten who was teething at the time and the vet basically tried to fear me into thinking she was beginning to have gingivitis and it felt she was pushing a certain food and a complete dry food diet for my kitten. After getting a second opinion at another clinic my kitten was clearly just teething. 2) the vet noticed a spot on my kittens ear and said it could be ringworm. She did no further testing and did not elaborate on any tests she could do or anything I could look out for, even when I asked her. After doing some research myself online I found that there were multiple tests she could have done on the spot. The second clinic confirmed it to be ringworm by testing and treating it immediately.
Giving 2 stars only because the front desk staff was nice and cordial during my visit. Otherwise a mega waste of time and money, and my poor cat had to endure ringworm until our visit with the better vet at Petit Laurier.
Best vet. Took the time to listen, followed up after my cat was sick, followed up with my insurance to make sure they paid up, super friendly and empathetic. Thank you!

Thank you so much for your fantastic review!
Lisa :)
Our cat has been a patient for two years and a half and the experience has always been nice and professional. The vets truly care about the animals and treat them with respect and kindness 🫶🏻 …
I really couldn’t recommend them more. Always so helpful, including anytime I’ve called with questions or concerns about my dog. Really grateful to have such a great veterinary clinic near me.

They told me blood test results would take 25-30 minutes and I still haven't gotten them more than 48 hours later. My am so worried about my dog it is making me sick. After several follow-ups, they transfered the file without my consent to another clinic, the one that provoked the need for bloodwork and a 2nd opinion. Very unprofessional conduct, which I believe to be in violation of their code of conduct. It feels like blatant indifference towards my animal's well-being, never mind the owner's mental well-being waiting on results indefinitely.

It feels like home, Dr. Dib is wonderful with our little angels (who can sometimes be difficult to manage during consultations), he takes the time to explain things thoroughly, and you can feel his concern for their well-being. A great find for me.

Even though he was overwhelmed, he took the time to explain everything in detail, performed the necessary tests, and addressed all the relevant points.
